verses.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ ׀ אַשְׁרֵי־אִ֭ישׁ יָרֵ֣א אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝מִצְוֹתָ֗יו חָפֵ֥ץ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.ar: هَلِّلُويَا. طُوبَى لِلرَّجُلِ ٱلْمُتَّقِي ٱلرَّبِّ، ٱلْمَسْرُورِ جِدًّا بِوَصَايَاهُ.
verses.en: Hallelujah. Happy is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in His commandments.
verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed [is] the man [that] feareth the LORD, [that] delighteth greatly in his commandments.
verses.web: Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.

verses.he: גִּבֹּ֣ור בָּ֭אָרֶץ יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְעֹ֑ו דֹּ֭ור יְשָׁרִ֣ים יְבֹרָֽךְ׃
verses.ar: نَسْلُهُ يَكُونُ قَوِيًّا فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ. جِيلُ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِينَ يُبَارَكُ.
verses.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth; the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.kjv: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.web: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.

verses.ar: رَغْدٌ وَغِنًى فِي بَيْتِهِ، وَبِرُّهُ قَائِمٌ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.en: Wealth and riches are in his house; and his merit endureth for ever.
verses.kjv: Wealth and riches [shall be] in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.web: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

verses.he: זָ֘רַ֤ח בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ אֹ֖ור לַיְשָׁרִ֑ים חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם וְצַדִּֽיק׃
verses.ar: نُورٌ أَشْرَقَ فِي ٱلظُّلْمَةِ لِلْمُسْتَقِيمِينَ. هُوَ حَنَّانٌ وَرَحِيمٌ وَصِدِّيقٌ.
verses.en: Unto the upright He shineth as a light in the darkness, gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
verses.kjv: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: [he is] gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
verses.web: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.

verses.he: טֹֽוב־אִ֭ישׁ חֹונֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה יְכַלְכֵּ֖ל דְּבָרָ֣יו בְּמִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.ar: سَعِيدٌ هُوَ ٱلرَّجُلُ ٱلَّذِي يَتَرَأَّفُ وَيُقْرِضُ. يُدَبِّرُ أُمُورَهُ بِٱلْحَقِّ.
verses.en: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth, that ordereth his affairs rightfully.
verses.kjv: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
verses.web: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.

verses.he: כִּֽי־לְעֹולָ֥ם לֹא־יִמֹּ֑וט לְזֵ֥כֶר עֹ֝ולָ֗ם יִהְיֶ֥ה צַדִּֽיק׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ لَا يَتَزَعْزَعُ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ. ٱلصِّدِّيقُ يَكُونُ لِذِكْرٍ أَبَدِيٍّ.
verses.en: For he shall never be moved; the righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.
verses.kjv: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
verses.web: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.

verses.he: מִשְּׁמוּעָ֣ה רָ֭עָה לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א נָכֹ֥ון לִ֝בֹּ֗ו בָּטֻ֥חַ בַּיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: لَا يَخْشَى مِنْ خَبَرِ سُوءٍ. قَلْبُهُ ثَابِتٌ مُتَّكِلًا عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings; his heart is stedfast, trusting in the LORD.
verses.kjv: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
verses.web: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.

verses.he: סָמ֣וּךְ לִ֭בֹּו לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר־יִרְאֶ֣ה בְצָרָֽיו׃
verses.ar: قَلْبُهُ مُمَكَّنٌ فَلَا يَخَافُ حَتَّى يَرَى بِمُضَايِقِيهِ.
verses.en: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he gaze upon his adversaries.
verses.kjv: His heart [is] established, he shall not be afraid, until he see [his desire] upon his enemies.
verses.web: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

verses.he: פִּזַּ֤ר ׀ נָ֘תַ֤ן לָאֶבְיֹונִ֗ים צִ֭דְקָתֹו עֹמֶ֣דֶת לָעַ֑ד קַ֝רְנֹ֗ו תָּר֥וּם בְּכָבֹֽוד׃
verses.ar: فَرَّقَ أَعْطَى ٱلْمَسَاكِينَ. بِرُّهُ قَائِمٌ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ. قَرْنُهُ يَنْتَصِبُ بِٱلْمَجْدِ.
verses.en: He hath scattered abroad, he hath given to the needy; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted in honour.
verses.kjv: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
verses.web: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.

verses.he: רָ֘שָׁ֤ע יִרְאֶ֨ה ׀ וְכָעָ֗ס שִׁנָּ֣יו יַחֲרֹ֣ק וְנָמָ֑ס תַּאֲוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃
verses.ar: ٱلشِّرِّيرُ يَرَى فَيَغْضَبُ. يُحَرِّقُ أَسْنَانَهُ وَيَذُوبُ. شَهْوَةُ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ تَبِيدُ.
verses.en: The wicked shall see it, and be vexed; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away; the desire of the wicked shall perish.
verses.kjv: The wicked shall see [it], and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
verses.web: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
